class.name: JRPGPresentationPort
class.brief_description: Where event commands ask the player something: messages, choices, numbers.
class.description: Event commands that need the player (a message to read, choices, a number to enter) send requests through a presentation port, with [method JRPGInterpreter.present]. A request is a kind and its parameters; the kinds and parameters are those of the commands that send them. The port keeps the requests in the order they were sent and shows the first one not yet answered, one at a time: requests from several events (an autorun and a parallel process, say) never show together. The presenter answers the shown request with [method reply], and the next one is shown at once. An interpreter that stops waiting (it was cleared, freed or moved on) withdraws its request; the presenter hides it if it was shown. This class only keeps the requests: presenting them is a subclass's job. The local port draws windows on the running map; online, the network port sends the requests to the client. A script can present them by overriding [method _show] and [method _hide]. Authority: server for what is asked and the answers it takes; the presenter is the client.

method.name: _hide
method.description: Called when request [param id], shown, is withdrawn: take it away from the screen.

method.name: _show
method.description: Called when request [param id] of kind [param kind] with [param params] is to be shown. Call [method reply] when the player answers; it may be called at once.

method.name: get_shown_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of the request shown, or an empty [StringName].

method.name: get_shown_params
method.description: Returns a copy of the parameters of the request shown, or an empty [Dictionary].

method.name: get_shown_request
method.description: Returns the id of the request shown, or [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_waiting_count
method.description: Returns how many requests wait for an answer, the shown one included.

method.name: has_request
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while request [param id] is kept: not yet answered, or answered and its answer not yet taken.

method.name: is_answered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when request [param id] was answered and its answer not yet taken.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while requests wait for an answer: the player answers rather than walks.

method.name: reply
method.description: For the presenter: answers the shown request [param id] with [param value], then shows the next request. Only the shown request can be answered; another id returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: send
method.description: Queues a request of kind [param kind] with [param params] and returns its id (1, 2, ...). It is shown now when no other request is.

method.name: take_reply
method.description: Returns the answer to request [param id] and forgets the request; [code]null[/code] when it has no answer yet.

method.name: withdraw
method.description: Forgets request [param id], whose interpreter no longer waits; if it was shown, it is hidden and the next request is shown.

signal.name: request_answered
signal.description: Emitted when the shown request [param id] is answered with [param value].

signal.name: request_hidden
signal.description: Emitted when the shown request [param id] is withdrawn.

signal.name: request_shown
signal.description: Emitted when request [param id] of kind [param kind] with [param params] is shown, before the presenter shows it.
